companies.name: Jihaan's Flower Emporium
companies.distributes: Chocolate gift boxes and snack boxes with branded chocolate (Cadbury Dairy Milk, Cadbury Astros, Nestle KitKat, Tex), sweets and gummies (Maynards Jelly Babies, Beacon Liquorice Allsorts, Skittles) and crisps; Easter and Eid gifts
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers through its own online shop with same-day delivery across Cape Town; also listed on Mr D
companies.fit_rationale: Milnerton gift and flower shop whose Edible Gifts collection resells other companies' branded chocolate and sweets in snack boxes, including a Cadbury Gold Collection. Seasonal ranges for Christmas, Easter, Eid and Valentine's Day suit Diablo's gift boxes and chocolate. Small, founded in 2024.
what_they_do_well: Same-day delivery across Cape Town for orders placed before 2pm, with 155 customer reviews on its site.

companies.name: Gifts by Fusspot
companies.distributes: Gift hampers and boxes with branded chocolate (Lindt Lindor, Winston & Julia slabs), toffees and fudge (Maris Caramel Fudge), biscuits (Kerrys shortbread) and snacks
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers through its online gift shop, plus corporate and event gifting
companies.fit_rationale: Online gift studio in Noordhoek whose hampers are filled with other companies' packaged chocolate, fudge and biscuits, hand selected from suppliers. Its seasonal, occasion and corporate hampers are a direct home for Diablo's chocolate, biscuits and gift boxes for health-conscious recipients.
what_they_do_well: Cape Town online gift studio offering corporate and event gifting alongside occasion hampers.

companies.name: Planned Gifts
companies.distributes: Gift boxes with chocolate and nougat categories and pantry items, sourced from other small local businesses
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers through its online store and Maitland gift shop, with same-day delivery across Cape Town
companies.fit_rationale: Maitland luxury gift store with its own Chocolates and Nougat categories, filled with items bought from other local small businesses. Small shop; the chocolate brands it stocks are not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Founded in May 2020; same-day delivery across Cape Town and gift boxes built from women and youth founded local businesses.

companies.name: Gift-ology
companies.distributes: Chocolate hampers and a Chocolate and Nuts collection; halaal-friendly gift boxes
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers through its online shop, plus corporate gifting in Cape Town
companies.fit_rationale: Cape Town gift box business selling chocolate hampers and a Chocolate and Nuts collection, hand packed for shoppers and companies. Its halaal-friendly, alcohol-free positioning matches Diablo's halal certificate. Small, and the chocolate brands it uses are not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Halaal-friendly, alcohol-free hampers with same-day delivery in Cape Town for orders before noon.

companies.name: It's a Wrap
companies.distributes: Custom and pre-made gift hampers with chocolate hampers, snacks and sweet treats from other producers
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers through its website
companies.fit_rationale: Tokai hamper service that fills vintage tins and baskets with snacks and sweet treats bought from other producers, and sells chocolate hampers. Small owner-run business; brand names are not shown on its website.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 2021 in Tokai, offering custom hampers made to each customer's request.

companies.name: Aspen&Co
companies.distributes: Gift hampers with hamper treat categories for sweets (fruit bonbons, birds eggs, watermelon slices), biscuits and rusks, salty snacks and nuts
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers from its Woodstock shop and online, with Cape Town delivery
companies.fit_rationale: Woodstock florist and gift shop whose Order Hamper Treats menu sells packaged sweets, biscuits and rusks and snacks for its gift hampers. Small shop; the brands behind its treats are not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Boutique Cape Town florist and gift shop trading since 1987.

companies.name: Send a Surprise
companies.distributes: Snack hampers and chocolate gift boxes with branded chocolate truffles (Tomes), jelly beans and biscuits
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers through its online shop, with same-day delivery in Cape Town and shipping within South Africa
companies.fit_rationale: Online gift shop listed among Cape Town gift delivery shops, selling snack hampers and chocolate gift boxes that include other brands such as Tomes truffles. Its head office city is not stated on its website.

companies.name: Luxebox
companies.distributes: Curated gift boxes with branded chocolate (Wedgewood chocolate enrobed macadamias), biscuits (The Treat Co tea biscuits) and coffee
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate clients and shoppers through its online shop, with a dedicated Cape Town corporate gifting service
companies.fit_rationale: Corporate gift box company that buys other brands' chocolate and biscuits for its boxes and actively sells corporate gifting in Cape Town. Smaller reach in Cape Town than in Johannesburg, and its delivery area is not stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Has made custom branded gift boxes for BMW, Volkswagen and Mini.
